questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It tells drivers that the right lane is ending and traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and prevent brake damage.

questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It indicates that a divided highway is starting, and you should stay in the right lane.

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed at locations where you are not allowed to enter, such as one-way streets or expressway ramps in the wrong direction. Do not pass this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black symbols. It alerts you that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns you that pedestrians may be crossing the road. Be alert and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow warning sign with black markings. It warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns. It is illegal to make a left turn at an intersection with this sign posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. Then proceed only when it is safe. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that traffic will be merging ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is ahead. You should check your brakes before going down the hill.

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It warns drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see it at intersections where making a U-turn would be unsafe due to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a full stop. Then check for traffic in all directions before you proceed.

questions.explanation: A round sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.

Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
